messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm adding a short geo-content footnote for EU/CA residency to the localization guide. Need to update SDK samples and migration guide. cc @kim @jason :wave:

jason: Good call. Do we have the exact legal wording? Legal asked for concise phrasing about processing and potential routing to partner regions.

maria: Draft: "Content may be processed in regional infrastructure based on customer residency settings \u2014 see /legal/data-residency." Planning to mention Private for strict residency. Any issues?

kim: Legal wants an opt-in sentence in the migration guide. I'll get a one-line approved variant. Also request SDK examples show header + env var, e.g. X-Redwood-Region or alias.

henry: For SDK samples, propose showing both env var and header: 
```
// JS SDK
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1' })
client.generate(...)
```
and HTTP example:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -H \"X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Include a one-line fallback note.

eva: Translation teams need the legal sentence kept as a single string so translators can place it properly. l10n-bot, please open a translation job.

l10n-bot: created T-832: "geo residency footnote" with context: "short legal sentence + link".

jason: Also can we include the fallback behavior in samples? e.g., if region unavailable, we serve from global and log a warning. Useful for migration guide troubleshooting.

henry: I'll add a comment and a mock 503 response in migration guide. Example: 
```
// if requested region unavailable -> server returns 503 + `X-Redwood-Fallback: global`
```
and example response body in the guide.

maria: Action list: kim get legal OK (EOD), henry update JS + curl snippets + fallback (PR), jason add migration-guide opt-in + env var example, eva coordinate translations once T-832 ready.

kim: Legal prefers "processed" over "routed". Proposed wording: "Content may be processed in regional infrastructure based on customer residency settings. Customers with strict in-country residency should use Redwood Private. See: /legal/data-residency". I'll post the approved one-liner on the PR.

maria: That phrasing works. Please include the Private deployment pointer in parentheses.

jason: I'll draft migration-guide PR including `REDWOOD_REGION` env var, env example, and a short FAQ item for troubleshooting. Will add checklist for reviewers.

henry: Drafting docs PR now: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12878 — includes JS + curl, alias header note, fallback comment, and inline footnote anchor. Requesting reviews from @maria and @kim.

maria: Small ask: can header be `X-Region` instead of `X-Redwood-Region`? We have `X-Region` used elsewhere in internal examples.

henry: Prefer `X-Redwood-Region` to avoid collision in customer infra. I'll show both variants in examples and mark recommended = `X-Redwood-Region`.

eva: l10n note: keep the legal sentence intact; l10n-bot attach context and character limits.

l10n-bot: updated T-832 with developer context and char limits; moved to "ready for translation".

kim: Marketing will want a short blurb for the public Regions landing page. They'll take the phrase after merge. Please coordinate with marketing once wording is final.

maria: Add a quick checklist to PRs: legal wording used, footnote anchor present, SDK sample shows header + env var, fallback snippet included, l10n request ID T-832.

jason: Will include checklist in PR 12890 (migration guide). ETA tomorrow morning for my PR.

henry: Pushed update, added example cURL response for fallback: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Redwood-Fallback: global
{
  "error": "requested region unavailable, served from fallback",
  "requested_region": "eu-west-1",
  "served_from": "global"
}
```

maria: Reviewing now. Will approve once jason's migration note is included. :shipit:

kim: Legal approved — leaving a short comment on the PR with final wording.

eva: After merge I'll create translation tasks and assign FR/DE/ES to vendors.

jason: PR 12890 (migration guide) merged. I'll add a mini changelog entry and link the l10n task.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update the docs checklist doc and close this thread. If anything regresses, reopen or ping #docs.

henry: I'll monitor post-merge for snippet feedback. :thumbsup:

l10n-bot: T-832 moved to "in translation" for FR/DE/ES.

maria: archived; linking back to PR for traceability. end of thread.
